label: Stride-N sampling + async analyzer fanout + SAM2/RTMPose CUDA on DGX Spark

smoke.note: frame_stride=6 auto-computed from 60fps source (round(60/10)=6). SAM2 propagated all 1798 frames for mask continuity; only 300 output to JSON. 20 Gemini windows (vs 119 M1 = 6.0x fewer).

download_plus_detect.note: Boxes pre-supplied; detection step bypassed (same as M0/M1)

tracking.models: SAM2 hiera-base-plus (CUDA, offload_video_to_cpu=False, offload_state_to_cpu=False) + RTMPose CUDA EP + DINOv2
tracking.note: S7 CUDA offload-disable confirmed in logs. Tracking wall unchanged from M1/M0 (stride does not skip SAM2 propagation frames, only output filtering).

upscale_analyze.models: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (CUDA FP16, S5 pre-scale 288px) + Gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview (async consumer, S4)
upscale_analyze.note: S4 async consumer confirmed in logs ('Analyzing window X async'). S5 pre-scale reduces ESRGAN input ~3.5x in area vs M1. Gemini 11.5s/window avg vs 45.8s M1 = 4.0x speedup per window; 20 windows vs 119 M1 = 6.0x fewer windows. Combined 23.7x speedup on upscale+analyze stage.

full_fixture_projection.note: Tracking now dominates at ~80% of projected full-fixture wall. M3 must address tracking throughput (S9: multi-job parallelism or S12: skip-propagation stride) to reach 60-min goal.

m2_done_criterion.note: Met with 0.43 min margin. Full-fixture 60-min criterion NOT met (~93 min projected); tracking is now the sole bottleneck.

feature_confirmations.S11_stride_sampling: frame_stride=6 confirmed in worker log; 300/1798 frames output
feature_confirmations.S4_async_analyzer: 'Analyzing window X async' confirmed in service log; 20 windows all async
feature_confirmations.S8_rtmpose_cuda: RTMPose loaded on cuda EP confirmed in service log

new_tests: tests/test_stride_sampling.py (7 tests: stride filtering, auto-stride from fps, integration)
tests.note: test_enhance_batch_mixed_size_semantic flaky (ordering-dependent GPU state) — pre-existing from M1, not M2 regression

verdict.qualitative: M2 delivers 23.7x speedup on the upscale+analyze stage and 5.1x speedup on end-to-end smoke wall time. The smoke criterion (<=22 min) is met at 21m 34s. Full-fixture projection ~93 min remains above the 60-min goal because tracking now dominates at ~80% of wall time (unchanged from M0/M1 at ~568 ms/frame, ~75 min for full fixture). M3 must attack tracking throughput.
next_actions: M3 S9: multi-job parallelism (run 2-4 concurrent tracking jobs on gx10 — memory headroom confirmed at 128 GB unified). Each additional parallel job multiplies tracking throughput proportionally.
M3 S12 (optional): skip-propagation stride in SAM2 — only propagate every Nth frame at the SAM2 level too, trading mask continuity for speed.
Tracking bottleneck breakdown: SAM2 hiera-base-plus is ~400-450 ms/frame; RTMPose + DINOv2 + overhead is ~120 ms/frame. S9 parallelism is the highest-leverage single lever.
